title: Customer totals via CTE
prompt: Using a CTE named customer_totals that computes total amount spent per customer_id (as total), return customer_id and total for customers whose total exceeds 100.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE ord10 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount REAL); INSERT INTO ord10 VALUES (1,1,50.0),(2,1,30.0),(3,2,200.0),(4,3,10.0),(5,2,100.0);
reference_sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM ord10 GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT customer_id, total FROM customer_totals WHERE total > 100;
